name: NSW Toll Relief weekly cap
summary: NSW drivers on a personal toll account can claim back weekly toll spending between $50 and $400, every three months.
key: Claim a $50 cap toll relief rebate every 3 months.
who: NSW residents with a personal toll account making personal trips in a privately registered vehicle.
how: Link your toll account to your MyServiceNSW Account, then apply on the Service NSW toll relief page.
catches: Covers weekly toll spend between $50 and $400, and personal trips up to $350 a week per tag and plate.

evidence.quote: claim a $50 cap toll relief rebate every 3 months
